problem_text:
A regional sales representative must conduct in-person visits to eight distinct corporate offices.

The travel times between offices are quantified in minutes:
* Office Alpha to Office Beta: 177.3 minutes
* Alpha to Gamma: 32.4 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 30.7 minutes
* Alpha to Epsilon: 119.9 minutes
* Alpha to Zeta: 141.7 minutes
* Alpha to Eta: 158.8 minutes
* Alpha to Theta: 108.7 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 150.7 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 190.7 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 83.4 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 184.9 minutes
* Beta to Eta: 73.9 minutes
* Beta to Theta: 184.9 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 40.5 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 87.9 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 151.5 minutes
* Gamma to Eta: 143.3 minutes
* Gamma to Theta: 122.6 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 122.4 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 172.4 minutes
* Delta to Eta: 182.1 minutes
* Delta to Theta: 139.1 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 191.6 minutes
* Epsilon to Eta: 120.0 minutes
* Epsilon to Theta: 175.7 minutes
* Zeta to Eta: 116.5 minutes
* Zeta to Theta: 36.0 minutes
* Eta to Theta: 125.2 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient itinerary that requires a single visit to each office and concludes by returning to the initial departure point.
